name: nmap
label: nmap
description: Nmap service/version detection: what runs on the IP's top 100 TCP ports (or on one port). Connect scan, no host discovery, no OS detection, no scripts beyond -sV's own.
contacts: connects to TCP ports of {target} (the top 100, or the one port; at most 50 probes per second, connect scan) and sends service-detection probes, including nmap's built-in version-detection scripts (no other scripts)
